guard: The reference simulator enforces the ask schema shorthand: a non-conforming reply consumes an attempt and exhausted attempts are L4006, and a schema the handler cannot read is refused (L4022), never silently skipped. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: the conformance check is skipped and every reply passes
mutations.expectRed: a non-conforming reply costs an attempt and the next one is checked
mutations.completionMarker: ok two parked sleeps deliver in wake order, not ask order, each at its own wake
mutations.cell: a non-conforming reply costs an attempt and the next one is checked
mutations.note: With the check gone the first (non-conforming) scripted reply is returned as the answer, so the cell that expects the SECOND reply after one consumed attempt is the first to see it.

mutations.name: an unreadable schema silently degrades to accept-any-record
mutations.expectRed: a schema the handler cannot read is refused (L4022), never silently skipped
mutations.cell: a schema the handler cannot read is refused (L4022), never silently skipped
mutations.note: The exact fallback the no-fallbacks rule forbids: the schema the program wrote is quietly not checked. Everything upstream stays green because readable schemas still resolve; only the L4022 cell can see it.
